newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Whittman-Hart started buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Whittman-Hart started buy.

text.p: -- Whittman-Hart Inc was started with a buy rating by Stephens Inc analyst Dathan Gaskill.
-- The information technology firm is expected to earn $0.45 in 1997 and $0.63 in 1998.
-- The company focuses on "middle market" companies and divisions of Fortune 1000 companies with revenues of $50 million to $500 milllion, Gaskill said in a report.
-- Cited strong sales and service model at Chicago-based Whittman-Hart and said company plans to grow from its nine branch offices to 30 within five years.
